algolia.name: GoPro - HERO HD Waterproof Action Camera
algolia.description: GoPro HERO HD Waterproof Action Camera: Capture footage of your adventures in HD with this waterproof action camera from GoPro. GoPro's wearable, mountable design makes it easy to capture the action from your unique first-person perspective. The GoPro HERO HD waterproof camera's user-friendly video modes like QuikCapture, SuperView, and Auto Low Light make it easier to achieve professional-quality video.
